description: Land title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to land parcel in Kapumulugoda, Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District  - Cad. Map No.810150 and to 08 other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and property registration matters across multiple districts. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures, making it a clear fit for the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
